description: Dams (Angus Catchment) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. The Angas Catchment Dams dataset is a subset of the Hydro Water Bodies dataset and is limited geographically to the Angas River surface water catchment in South Australia. The data set contains polygon data outlining the physical extent of dams and estimated dam capacity (volume range in megalitres) and wall height information (in metres). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are Water resources, emergency response, natural resources, water. It offers 3 resource(s) in DOCX, HTML, MIXED SPATIAL FORMATS. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
